capabilities: Pair a device with the inbox server using a one-time setup code
Poll the server every 10 seconds for items waiting for the device
Download files to temporary .part files, place them, and verify SHA-256 checksums
Mirror an optional shared knowledge base into a dedicated vault folder
Unbind the current device from the command palette
disambiguation: Not a general data-transfer or two-way sync tool; it only receives items from the server and never pushes vault changes back.
extras: README is written in Chinese. It documents migration from an earlier mirror mode: switching to inbox mode deletes unchanged mirrored files and the local .git folder while preserving edited and user-written files.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to receive notes and attachments delivered from an outside server; sync tools are typically two-way and can overwrite local edits.
summary: Pulls items from a personal inbox server into the vault every 10 seconds after one-time code pairing, adding files without overwriting or deleting.
